params.body:
Replaces #231.

The signals under a trend were a grid of stone cards, six in view and the rest behind "Show all N signals". With every signal now sent for readers who have the sources, a trend on fifty signals became a wall of cards each labelled "Signal" and "View source", with notes cut mid-sentence and the same source repeated on card after card.

Now the evidence reads as who said what, and when:

- **Grouped by source**, the source that gave most first: a block per source with its name and "N signals" on the left (a hairline above, like a row of the trend list), its signals on the right, newest first.
- **The day of each signal** on the right, with a quiet ↗ when it can be followed; the whole line is the link. A report chunk says "report" instead.
- **One line on top**: "Every signal this reading is built from: 52 from 38 sources, 16 Jul 2026 to 21 Oct 2026."
- **Nothing folds away.**

A reader without the sources still gets six notes, without source, day or link, and the "+ N more signals feed this trend" counter as the last row with its upgrade link.

The day, the platform and the whole note come from the pipeline (gentells-pipeline #380). Without them the page shows no day and the note as it comes, so either can merge first.

- `partials/signal-card` replaced by `partials/signal-group`
- `TrendSignalsTest`: the summary line, the grouping order and the source named once per group

Tests: 476 of 477 pass; `BuildStampTest` fails in a worktree as it always does.
